chapters.tagline: Yaks and the people who live and work with them.
chapters.intro: Yaks and the people who live and work with them: herders, high pastures, trek routes, bells and churpi. Tell us what you know about living with yaks.
chapters.cover_alt: Two black yaks grazing on a green mountain pasture.
prompts: The yak's year: up and down from the pastures
The sound of yak bells and herders' calls
What a yak gives, and what it costs to keep one

chapters.tagline: A Day in the Life: film someone doing their everyday work.
chapters.intro: Film someone doing their everyday work. It can be you, a neighbour, a shopkeeper, a teacher. Just follow them through their routine.
prompts: Opening a shop in the morning
Just 2–3 minutes following someone through their routine
chapters.cover_alt: A group of men, including monks and elders in traditional dress, posing together under a green-roofed shelter.

chapters.tagline: How It's Done: show how the work gets done.
chapters.intro: Process videos. Show how a piece of work is done, step by step, the way you would show someone who has never done it.
chapters.cover_alt: A man in a blue vest crouches on a terraced hillside field, picking leaves, beside a sign for the cultivation of aromatic plants.

chapters.tagline: A Place and Its Story: walk to a place and tell its story.
chapters.intro: Walk to a place and tell its story. Stand right there, and say what you know about it.
prompts: Walk to a rock, tree, spring, path or house
Stand there and tell the story connected to it
Show what it looks like now, and what you remember
chapters.cover_alt: Old moss-covered stone shrines beside a path in the forest, with painted figures on the front of one.

chapters.tagline: Because This Is How It's Always Been Done.
chapters.intro: The things done because this is how it has always been done. Show them and say why, in your own words.
prompts: Things done at specific times of year
chapters.cover_alt: A woman in a blue silk dress makes an offering at the altar of a monastery shrine room while a monk sits at a table.

chapters.intro: Film the animals that share your life, and what life with them is like.
prompts: Your family's animals at work or rest
The relationship between a person and an animal
chapters.cover_alt: Two young sheep with black and white faces resting among ferns.

chapters.intro: Women's work, shown by the women who do it, in their own way and their own time.
prompts: Cooking a meal from start to finish
Managing a household, a business, caring for children
chapters.cover_alt: Two women seen from behind, standing in front of a golden statue in a temple.

chapters.intro: How tourism has changed things, and what it looks like from here.
prompts: A place now, next to a photo of it 10 years ago, with the story
A job that exists because of tourists
The bazaar in tourist season, and at other times
What tourists don't see, and what they get wrong
chapters.cover_alt: The words "All organic welcome" painted in white on a rusty corrugated tin wall.

chapters.intro: Record what Yuksam sounds like. Hold still, press record, and let the place speak.
prompts: A river, a path, a field
chapters.cover_alt: Monks seated in a prayer room playing horns, a drum and bells.

chapters.intro: Anything that matters to you. There is no wrong answer here.
chapters.cover_alt: A road at dusk lined with tall white prayer flags beside forested mountains, with a few people walking.
